summary: Category System bug-fix verification (backend only). Ran 24 targeted pytest cases against the public API on https://casting-master-dna.preview.emergentagent.com/api — 24/24 passed (100%). All requirements from the review request are verified: admin categories are the single source of truth, /api/products/categories is now parity-sourced from db.categories, duplicate/whitespace/case-insensitive names are rejected (409), empty names return 400, auto-link on create honours exact normalized match (no fuzzy), product filter is case/whitespace insensitive, Bowl Mill Components returns exactly 5 products, PATCH rename cascades to products & rename-clashes 409, disable hides from public, delete preserves product records, cleanup is idempotent (0/0/0), RBAC enforced on all admin endpoints (401/403 without token), regression counts hold (87 products, materials list, videos, guest RFQ). DB left in the same state as found (all temp categories/products deleted, Bowl Mill Components restored, Pump Castings recreated).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1662 lines — recommend splitting into routers (auth, products, categories, media, rfq) in a future refactor. Not blocking.

Public /api/categories returns categories with 'display_order' but sort tie-breaker is undefined — currently ok because seeded orders differ; consider secondary sort by name for deterministic ordering.
admin_create_category doesn't validate parent_id existence when provided (not exercised in this bug-fix scope, flagging for future).
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test created and then deleted: (a) 'Test Category Alpha', (b) product 'TEST_TempProduct_Autolink' + category 'TempCat XYZ', (c) temporarily renamed 'Bowl Mill Components' -> 'Bowl Mill Assemblies' then reverted, (d) temporarily disabled 'Steel Mill Parts' then re-enabled, (e) deleted 'Pump Castings' admin category then recreated (products untouched, only admin record recreated).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 24 category-system tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_category_system.py and are idempotent — safe to re-run. Guest RFQ payload requires company_name, contact_person, project_details (not customer_name/company/message). /api/products/categories now returns {"categories": [...]} shape; the test tolerates either list or dict-wrapped list. Cleanup MUST return 0/0/0 on a clean DB — do not run it after manually adding duplicate rows without cleaning up.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration was verification of a completed bug fix, not a bug hunt. All specified behaviours confirmed.
